_meta.description: Hand-curated X (Twitter) posts, newest first. Each post is printed as a ruled row (date, author, text); X's script loads only when a reader asks for one full post with its photos. 'status' grades the post's claims, not the account: posts by enthusiasts are 'reported' at best. Dates come from the post ID.

posts.author: Saurabh Raut
posts.text: Line 4's trains go to the Mandale depot. The Alstom trains will be received at Mandale first, then at Kasheli, and will move to Mogharpada once it is ready.
